test_title: RRB NTPC CBT 2 (Level-2) Official Paper (Held On: 13 June 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: If letters of the English alphabet are written in reverse order then which letter is 2ⁿd to the right of 9th letter from the left?
solution:
9th letter from the left:

(Left) Z Y X W V U T S **R** Q P O N M L K J I H G F E D C B A (Right)

2nd to the right of 9th letter from the left:

(Left) Z Y X W V U T S R Q **P** O N M L K J I H G F E D C B A (Right)

Hence, ‘**P**’ is the correct answer.
